director_decision: Director reviewed the A/B/C option board and approved refinement of A toward B: A-prime Quiet Recognition.

refinement_delta.body_travel: Removed the local recognition slowdown; visible passage is constant-speed through normalized travel 0.08..0.92 with easing only at hidden endpoints.

drive_scan_applied: Original concept and V0 studies: shared Stage and consequence over decorative effect.
V2.2 Stage doctrine: Stage remains primary and threshold remains mysterious rather than portal-like.
Bellweather accepted motion studies: gala stroll and doorway glance support forward motion plus restrained observational recognition.
Mascot vision / natural expression: recognition should come from posture and gaze rather than a promotional pose.
Website mascot integration: environmental scale, discovered after the Stage, crossing/departing stronger than standing presentation.
Temporal choreography: Bellweather absence restores Stage authority and consequence can linger after the person is gone.
Late Arrival reset: one continuous encounter, not a slideshow or numbered state machine.
Concealed Production refinement: practical black masking and pre-existing indirect plum-violet/mineral-teal latent presence; no magical activation.
prototype_reading: Bellweather begins outside the visible doorway clip in the right/blue territory.
She crosses inward at environmental scale with continuous body travel and no recognition pause.
Recognition is a brief, reduced head turn while forward travel continues.
Scale stays comparatively stable through recognition, then recedes near the threshold.
Existing working-black masking physically occludes the exit; no fade or portal transition is used.
Plum/teal latent light is already present and does not animate in response to Bellweather.
A soft contact shadow and faint threshold reflection are the only environmental consequences; both settle away.
The Stage and camera never move.
